symbols.name: base-2 logarithm
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm, as used in the expression $n \log n$.

symbols.name: binary logarithm
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm of n rounded up to an integer and never below 1.
symbols.quote: Write $\lg n = \max\{\lceil \log_2 n\rceil, 1\}$ for the base-2 logarithm of $n$ rounded up to an integer and never below $1$.

symbols.name: lower-bound constant
symbols.meaning: A positive constant in the lower bound that must hold for machine A.
symbols.quote: The conjecture says that for every such machine $A$ there are a positive constant $c_A$ and a threshold $N_A$ on the input length such that the following holds.

symbols.name: threshold length
symbols.meaning: The input length from which the lower bound for machine A must hold.
symbols.quote: The conjecture says that for every such machine $A$ there are a positive constant $c_A$ and a threshold $N_A$ on the input length such that the following holds.

symbols.name: saving exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed positive constant in the exponent 1 - kappa of the main theorem's running time, equal to 2^{-182}.
symbols.quote: The main theorem gives one fixed machine $A$ with $T_A(n) = O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa$ is a fixed positive constant.

relations.quote: The conjecture bounds the cost of [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md) from below.
The conjecture is negated through the [limit inferior](limit-inferior.md) of the ratio $T_A(n)/(n\lg n)$.
